mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( EMAIL, PASSWORD_HASH, NICKNAME, NAME, BIRTH_DATE, GENDER, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL, ROLE, OAUTH_PROVIDER, OAUTH_PROVIDER_ID, PHONE, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{name}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{profileImageUrl}, #{role}, #{oauthProvider}, #{oauthProviderId}, #{phone}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE') )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
SELECT * FROM USERS WHERE EMAIL = #{email} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET NICKNAME = #{nickname}, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL = #{profileImageUrl}, PHONE = #{phone}, NAME = #{name}, BIRTH_DATE = #{birthDate}, GENDER = #{gender} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USERS SET OAUTH_PROVIDER = NULL, OAUTH_PROVIDER_ID = NULL WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
